title: CompTIA CySA+ CS0-003 Nightmare Diagnostic Bank v2

questions.target: 1.1 Log correlation / clock and zone normalization
questions.stem:
Three sources record activity involving workstation WS-31. The proxy logs in UTC. The domain controller logs at a fixed UTC-5 offset. The EDR agent logs in local time (UTC+1), and its clock was later measured 90 seconds fast.

Proxy: 14:02:10 POST files.example-share.net, 3.2 MB out
DC: 09:01:05 Kerberos TGT request (4768), svc-backup, source WS-31
EDR: 15:01:50 mshta.exe launched by OUTLOOK.EXE on WS-31

Which conclusion is best supported after normalization?

options.A: mshta launch, TGT request, then upload; the launch and ticket request are unrelated events
options.B: TGT request, mshta launch, then upload; the service account likely triggered the launch
options.C: mshta launch, TGT request, then upload; the ticket request cannot have caused the launch
options.D: TGT request, upload, then mshta launch; the launch was cleanup activity after the transfer

questions.stem: A containerized storefront runs on autoscaling worker nodes that are terminated after 20 minutes of idle time. After a suspected pod compromise, responders find the pod's logs gone because its node was reclaimed. Which architecture change would best prevent this evidence loss?

options.A: Ship container and cluster audit logs to a collector off the node
options.B: Extend log retention on each worker node's local disk to thirty days
options.C: Raise application logging to debug level inside the container images
options.D: Take a nightly snapshot of every worker node's volume and retain it

questions.stem: Authentication logs show one external IP address making 3 failed sign-in attempts against each of 600 accounts, spaced hours apart over 18 hours, followed by a single success on one account. The lockout policy is 5 failures in 15 minutes per account, and no account locked. Which detection logic would best have flagged this pattern before the successful sign-in?

options.A: Alert when any one account records three failures within a one-hour window
options.B: Alert when account lockouts exceed ten distinct accounts within a one-hour window
options.C: Alert when a single account fails from two or more countries within one day
options.D: Alert when one source address fails against many distinct accounts within 24 hours

questions.target: 1.2 Abnormal OS process behavior / process injection
questions.stem: An EDR alert shows notepad.exe, signed by Microsoft and started at user logon with no command-line arguments, making an outbound TLS connection to a rarely seen external address. Which additional finding would best confirm process injection?

options.A: The parent process being explorer.exe, as with other user-launched programs
options.B: A private executable memory region in the process with no backing file on disk
options.C: The process having loaded winhttp.dll, a library that ships with Windows
options.D: The on-disk notepad.exe hash matching the vendor's published hash for that build

questions.stem: A network team must retain 90 days of evidence showing which hosts resolved which domains and which TLS server names they contacted, across 40 Gbps links. Policy prohibits storing payloads, and full packet capture is unaffordable. Which data source best meets the requirement?

options.A: NetFlow or IPFIX records exported from the core routers and retained 90 days
options.B: Protocol metadata logs, such as DNS and TLS server names, from a passive sensor
options.C: IDS signature alerts forwarded to the SIEM and retained for 90 days
options.D: Rolling seven-day full packet capture with an indexed search interface

questions.stem:
Headers from a message claiming to come from the payroll team, listed top to bottom:

Received: from mail-gw.corp.example (10.1.1.5) by mx.corp.example; Tue 14:03:10
Received: from relay7.bulkmail.example (198.51.100.23) by mail-gw.corp.example; Tue 14:03:08
Received: from payroll.corp.example (203.0.113.9) by relay7.bulkmail.example; Tue 14:02:55
From: payroll@corp.example

The company's payroll system has never sent mail through bulkmail.example. Which statement is best supported?

options.A: The third header is verified because it names the internal payroll system
options.B: The headers are in reverse order, so the third header records final delivery
options.C: The first header shows the message originated inside the corporate network
options.D: The second header is the last verifiable hop; relay7 wrote the third one

questions.target: 1.4 Threat hunting / telemetry for a persistence hypothesis
questions.stem: A hunt team hypothesizes that an adversary has established persistence through WMI permanent event subscriptions. Process-creation logging and firewall logs are already available. Which additional telemetry is required to test the hypothesis directly?

options.A: Sysmon events recording WMI event filter, consumer, and binding creation
options.B: Windows Security events recording service installation on each endpoint
options.C: Domain controller authentication logs for privileged account sign-ins
options.D: DNS query logs from the internal resolvers covering the last 30 days

questions.stem: A SOAR playbook automatically isolates any host with a high-severity EDR detection. A single false positive isolated a domain controller and caused an authentication outage. Which change best prevents the same class of failure while keeping automation for ordinary hosts?

options.A: Replace automatic isolation with an email notification to the SOC distribution list
options.B: Require two separate high-severity detections before the playbook isolates any host
options.C: Add a criticality check that requires analyst approval to isolate tier-0 systems
options.D: Lower EDR detection severity so fewer alerts reach the isolation threshold

questions.stem: Most laptops in the fleet are rarely on the corporate network or VPN during the nightly scan window. Leadership wants authenticated patch-level checks without adding scan traffic to the network. Which approach best meets this?

options.A: Extend the nightly credentialed network scan window to cover a full 72 hours
options.B: Mandate always-on VPN and keep the nightly credentialed network scan in place
options.C: Scan each laptop's public IP address from an external scanner every night
options.D: Deploy scan agents that report over the internet whenever a laptop is online

questions.target: 2.2 Scanner output / banner detection and backported fixes
questions.stem: A network scan flags a Linux server for a critical OpenSSH flaw because the service banner reports version 7.4. The server runs a vendor-supported enterprise distribution that backports security fixes, and the installed package is openssh-7.4p1-23.el7_9. What should the analyst do before classifying the finding?

options.A: Accept the finding as valid because the banner shows the vulnerable upstream version
options.B: Close the finding because a vendor-supported distribution would not ship a vulnerable build
options.C: Check the installed package changelog for the CVE named in the advisory
options.D: Rescan with a more intensive profile so the service reports a different banner

questions.target: 2.2 Debuggers / static vs dynamic binary analysis
questions.stem: An analyst must identify which functions in a stripped, unpacked malware sample call network APIs. Policy prohibits executing the sample on any system. Which approach is the best fit?

options.A: Disassemble and decompile the binary statically, for example with Ghidra
options.B: Set breakpoints on network API calls using Immunity Debugger in a lab VM
options.C: Step through the sample in GDB inside an isolated sandbox network segment
options.D: Run the strings utility against the file to list its readable text

questions.target: 2.3 Validation and context / reachability of vulnerable code
questions.stem: A container image scan reports a critical flaw in a JSON parsing library. Code review shows the vulnerable function is never called by the application, and the service accepts no inbound network connections. How should the finding be handled?

options.A: Raise its priority because rebuilt containers can reintroduce the vulnerable library
options.B: Keep it as a valid finding with lower priority and documented reachability evidence
options.C: Close it because the service accepts no inbound connections from any network
options.D: Mark it a false positive because the vulnerable function is not reached by the code

questions.stem: An API checks an account balance in one database statement and debits the account in a second statement. Testers send 20 simultaneous withdrawal requests and overdraw the account. Which fix most directly addresses the root cause?

options.A: Make the check and debit one atomic transaction with row-level locking
options.B: Require a one-time token on each withdrawal request to block replayed calls
options.C: Rate-limit withdrawals to one request per second for each account and client
options.D: Validate that each requested amount is positive and below the current balance

questions.stem: A service parses uploaded XML invoices. A tester submits a document that declares an external entity pointing to file:///etc/hostname, and the response includes the server's hostname. Which fix most directly removes the weakness?

options.A: Check that each upload is well-formed XML before handing it to the parser
options.B: Run the parser process under an unprivileged operating system service account
options.C: Block uploads containing the string ENTITY with a case-sensitive filter
options.D: Disable DTD and external entity processing in the XML parser settings

questions.stem: After a security update to a shared library on a Linux web server, the package manager reports success, but the next credentialed scan still flags the flaw. The scan evidence shows the vulnerable library version mapped into running web server processes. What should the analyst do first?

options.A: Grant the scanner account root privileges so it reads the true library version
options.B: Restart the web server services that still map the old library, then rescan
options.C: Reinstall the library from a different repository mirror and rescan
options.D: Mark the finding a false positive because the package manager reported success

questions.stem: A CI pipeline scans container images at build time and blocks any image with a critical finding. Six weeks after a clean build, a new critical CVE is published for a package inside a deployed image. Which control would best identify the exposure?

options.A: Sign every image at build time and verify its signature at deployment time
options.B: Run static analysis on the application's source repository on every commit
options.C: Rescan stored and running images against current vulnerability feeds
options.D: Lower the pipeline blocking threshold so builds fail on medium-severity findings

questions.stem: An investigator documents that an adversary compressed and password-protected files into an archive in a staging directory on a file server, then uploaded the archive to an external host over HTTPS. Which MITRE ATT&CK tactics best describe these two actions, in order?

options.A: Exfiltration for the staged archive, then Command and Control for the upload
options.B: Collection for the staged archive, then Exfiltration for the upload
options.C: Collection for the staged archive, then Command and Control for the upload
options.D: Impact for the staged archive, then Exfiltration for the upload

questions.stem: Counsel issues a legal hold covering three custodians involved in an incident. An automated retention job will purge mailbox items older than 30 days tonight. What should the responder do?

options.A: Suspend the purge for the three custodians and document the authorization
options.B: Allow the purge to run because retention policy takes precedence during incidents
options.C: Copy the three mailboxes to an analyst workstation, then allow the purge to run
options.D: Disable mailbox retention across the whole organization until counsel approves

questions.stem: Responders have confirmed three compromised hosts, four attacker-controlled C2 domains, and a service account in use. The attacker is actively reading customer records. Which containment approach is best?

options.A: Clean the implant from the first confirmed host now, then work through the rest
options.B: Block one C2 domain now and keep watching activity on the other channels
options.C: Delay containment until the attacker's full objectives are understood
options.D: Stage isolation of all hosts, domains, and the account, then execute together

questions.stem: A tabletop exercise reveals that, in an overnight scenario, responders spent two hours locating someone with authority to take the payment platform offline. Which preparation change best addresses the gap?

options.A: Give the on-shift SOC analyst authority to disable production systems unilaterally
options.B: Repeat the tabletop each quarter until response time improves on its own
options.C: Pre-delegate shutdown authority and an after-hours escalation path in the IR plan
options.D: Add a payment platform dashboard to the SOC display used by overnight shifts

questions.target: 3.2 Recovery / backup trust and dwell time
questions.stem: Forensic analysis shows the attacker first gained access 45 days ago. Nightly backups of the affected file server are retained for 30 days, and the business needs the server back today. Which recovery approach is best?

options.A: Restore the backup taken just before the first alert, which marks the intrusion
options.B: Restore the most recent backup, then run an anti-malware scan before reconnecting
options.C: Restore the oldest retained backup because it is least likely to hold the implant
options.D: Rebuild from a trusted baseline image and restore only validated data

questions.target: 4.1 Metrics / survivorship bias in remediation KPIs
questions.stem: A monthly report shows median time to remediate critical findings improved from 30 days to 12 days, yet the number of critical findings open longer than 90 days doubled. The median is calculated only from findings closed during the month. What best explains the divergence?

options.A: The remediation target was extended, which inflated the count of aged findings
options.B: The median counts only closed findings, so aged open findings are excluded
options.C: New assets joined the scan scope, which diluted the median time to remediate
options.D: Critical findings are being reclassified as high severity at the time of closure

questions.stem: A vendor discloses an actively exploited flaw in a VPN appliance with no patch available. Asset inventory shows 12 affected appliances, 3 of them internet-facing. What should the first leadership update emphasize?

options.A: A recommendation to defer communication until the vendor ships a tested patch
options.B: Confirmation that no compromise occurred because no alerts fired since disclosure
options.C: Affected assets and exposure, interim mitigations, and the next update time
options.D: CVSS vector details, exploit mechanics, and scanner plugin identifiers for each appliance

questions.stem: At 02:10 a SOC analyst sees confirmed ransomware indicators on a production file server. The severity matrix defines confirmed ransomware indicators on any production host as P1, requiring immediate executive notification. Encryption spread has not been measured. What should the analyst do?

options.A: Declare P1 and notify executives now, refining impact as facts emerge
options.B: Declare P2 now and raise it to P1 if encryption spreads within four hours
options.C: Notify the SOC manager and brief executives at the start of business
options.D: Hold notification until the number of encrypted hosts has been confirmed

questions.stem: An analyst is drafting the final incident report. Email delivery logs and EDR show a macro-enabled attachment executing minutes after delivery. No other initial access vector appears in the available telemetry, but VPN logs are retained for only 7 days and the intrusion began 20 days ago. Which statement is most appropriate?

options.A: Phishing was the initial vector because the attachment was delivered and the macro executed
options.B: The initial vector is unknown because the logs are incomplete and no assessment can be made
options.C: Phishing was the initial vector; the available logs confirm no other access method was used
options.D: Phishing is the assessed initial vector, moderate confidence; VPN logs for the period are gone
